title: Canonical configuration encoding
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $x$ be a finite Boolean string, let $s$ be a natural number, and let $C$ be a configuration of $N$ on input $x$. The Boolean string encoding $C$ in a window of radius $s$ is nonempty and has final bit true.
